exact_model.pathwise: Delta = DenseTotal-HybridTotal = sum_{j sparse}(d_j-s_j) - sum_j g_j - DeltaSetup, assuming dense-fallback calls are cost-matched to their dense counterfactuals and common costs cancel.
exact_model.homogeneous: Hybrid wins iff N*G + A < (N-k)*(D-S), for D>S; k is fallback count.
exact_model.probability_form: Under an IID/expectation model only: G + A/N < (1-p)*(D-S). This is not a stochastic law for CFD.
exact_model.all_fallback_corollary: If k=N (zero sparse calls), sparse-arithmetic savings are exactly zero; any aggregate DenseTotal-HybridTotal difference is non-sparse setup/control/timing effect.

decision_rules: Do not attribute an aggregate total-time delta to sparse arithmetic when sparse_calls=0.

For a new safety guard added to an otherwise identical frozen trace, a positive observed total margin D-H is the maximum additional per-trajectory overhead budget before that trace loses its measured total-time win; this is a trace budget, not a portability guarantee.
For prospective routing, measure D,S,G,A on the same provisioned host and use the pathwise inequality; fallback fraction alone is insufficient.
Retain dense fallback whenever the exact measured budget is non-positive or control/setup/timing effects are of the same order as the margin.
boundaries: Frozen host data are bounded author tests, not independent acceptance.
No continuous-PDE, industrial, portability, or generic 3D acceleration claim.
Aggregate medians do not identify per-decision causal costs.
The R12 current execution environment still cannot instantiate the pinned native host.
